title: Choose the visual world
question: The redesign can turn seed-data preparation into a recognizable operational ritual. Choose a direction, adopt an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Dispatch Manifest
options.lineage: warehouse dispatch sheets and export manifests
options.thesis: Every listing is a line item moving toward a verified presentation-data dispatch.
options.viewport: A compact dispatch desk pairs the two authoring routes with a visible Cars to Brand to Model to Listings sequence and a restrained transfer-readiness strip.
options.risk: Can feel bureaucratic if the form language becomes ornamental instead of shortening decisions.

raised.raise: The active task receives one unmistakable focus frame; everything else recedes.
Density adapts by priority without breaking the underlying information grid.
Compatibility and vehicle context read as an explicit relationship, never an implied label.
Long authoring flows move through named, inspectable stages rather than an undifferentiated page.

options.label: Technical Parts Register
options.lineage: industrial vehicle-parts catalogs and homologation registers
options.thesis: The shared vehicle catalog becomes the product's visual backbone, with listings treated as precise registered specimens.
options.viewport: An indexed catalog spread exposes Cars and Car Parts as parallel registers, with the brand-model-listing path drawn as the dominant operating structure.
options.risk: The most familiar automotive direction; weak execution could collapse into a themed documentation site.

options.label: Dense Catalog Mosaic
options.thesis: The entire working set becomes a precise mosaic of searchable modules with almost no wasted motion.
options.viewport: A persistent multi-row utility rail sits above tightly ruled Cars, Parts, catalog, and transfer modules, exposing more useful choices in one screen.
options.case: Matches repeated operational work and wins on scan density, but identifies less specifically with seed-data dispatch.
options.risk: Can become intimidating when every control competes at equal volume.

options.label: Concourse Registry
options.thesis: Listings and their states become fixed-column departures that can be understood in one long glance.
options.viewport: A full-width registry leads with vehicle context and rows for the Cars and Parts routes, using fixed columns and state lamps rather than dashboard cards.
options.case: Strong for listing tables and status changes, but less natural for forms and image-heavy review.
options.risk: The dark board can tire operators during long data-entry sessions.

options.label: Presentation Viewfinder
options.thesis: The active listing sits inside a strict presentation frame while readiness readouts stay at its edges.
options.viewport: One framed authoring target dominates while navigation and status occupy the safe-area corners.
options.case: Presentation language is relevant, but a single-frame topology obscures catalog browsing and comparison.
options.kept: An active task should receive strict focus and a quiet perimeter.
options.risk: HUD styling would become novelty across dense forms.

options.label: Glyph Workbench
options.thesis: Every object and state is rendered through one adaptable character grid.
options.viewport: A fixed character grid turns the catalog and listing counts into a terminal-like working scene.
options.case: Grid rigor is useful, but image review and approachable authoring lose too much clarity.
options.kept: Responsive layouts should preserve information priority instead of merely stacking everything.
options.risk: The material fights the media-rich listing content.

options.label: Compatibility Network
options.thesis: Vehicle, listing, media, and compatibility are shown as inspectable forces in one connected system.
options.viewport: The authoring routes branch from a visible relationship diagram with controls pinned to its nodes.
options.case: Clarifies relationships, but makes routine CRUD feel more complex than it is.
options.kept: Compatibility must be explicit, traceable, and visually distinct from part manufacturer.
options.risk: The network topology overstates a mostly linear workflow.

options.label: Presentation Cue Desk
options.thesis: Seed preparation moves through named cues from blank catalog context to presentation-ready data.
options.viewport: Horizontal bands stage the workflow from vehicle selection through listing preparation and review.
options.case: The presentation connection is true, but atmospheric bands weaken everyday data-entry clarity.
options.kept: Long workflows need named stages and an inspectable current position.
options.risk: Color and atmosphere could overpower operational state.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished neutral admin application with conventional navigation, cards, forms, and tables.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar top navigation and two module cards lead into searchable catalog grids.
canonCard.risk: Clear and familiar, but intentionally difficult to distinguish from other CRUD tools.
